details: The cryptocurrency market has seen a rebound, with total market capitalization rising and Bitcoin recovering to $63,200. This follows the most severe oversold conditions since 2020, suggesting that bears are taking profits and some investors are identifying long-term opportunities.
title: Crypto Market Rebounds From Oversold Conditions

details: MicroStrategy, led by Michael Saylor, has recommenced its Bitcoin accumulation strategy by acquiring an additional 1,550 BTC for approximately $101 million. This purchase marks the company's first since a brief selling episode in late May, bringing its total holdings to 845,256 BTC.
title: MicroStrategy Resumes Bitcoin Purchases, Buys 1,550 BTC

details: The FTX Token (FTT) has surged by over 50% following news that convicted FTX co-founder Sam Bankman-Fried (SBF) has formally submitted an application for a presidential pardon. This development has turned his clemency bid into a speculative trading event for FTT.
title: FTX Token (FTT) Spikes as SBF Seeks Presidential Pardon

details: Humanity Protocol, a Worldcoin rival, experienced an 88% crash in its native token, H. The dramatic decline was triggered by reports of a security incident involving a $30 million wallet drain, leading to significant investor panic and security concerns.
title: Humanity Protocol Token Crashes 88% Amid $30M Wallet Drain
